candidate.answerReason: In the usual school projection model, sunlight is approximately parallel over ordinary shadow distances, so a shadow in sunlight is the parallel-projection example, choice C.

methods.label: Recognizing parallel sunlight
methods.explanation: The Sun is very far from Earth, so sunlight can be approximated as parallel rays, forming parallel projection. Light from lamps and flashlights originates from a single point, producing central projection.
methods.levelReason: Recognizing idealized sunlight and nearby light sources is part of Grade 9 projection.
